lessons.title: Sharing the Harvest
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate sharing during a group harvest activity.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what 'harvest' means.
lessons.main_activity: Children sort and share a basket of real harvest fruit/veg equally between groups, discussing gratitude for food.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note cooperative sharing — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Class thank-you circle for the harvest.
lessons.home_link: Share something with a family member today.

lessons.title: Talking About Autumn Changes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe an autumn change using full sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an autumn leaf and describe it.
lessons.main_activity: Children discuss changes they've noticed outside (colder, leaves falling) in full sentences.
key_questions: How do you know it's autumn?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note descriptive sentence use — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Class list of autumn changes noticed.
lessons.home_link: Spot an autumn change on your way home.

lessons.title: Leaf Jumping and Raking Movements
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to jump with control and mimic raking movements.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm-up jumping on the spot.
lessons.main_activity: Outdoor (or indoor with paper leaves) activity jumping into leaf piles and practising raking/sweeping arm movements.
resources_needed: Real or paper leaves, toy rakes
key_questions: Can you rake the leaves into a pile?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note gross motor control and coordination — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down; discuss the fun of the activity.
lessons.home_link: Jump in leaves or help rake outside if possible.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'u'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'u' and blend words (sun, mud, cup).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'u' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'u'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 13 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending sun, mud, cup.

lessons.title: Counting Harvest Vegetables
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count harvest vegetables accurately up to 10.
lessons.starter_activity: Count a basket of vegetables together.
lessons.main_activity: Children count and sort harvest vegetables into groups, recording totals with tally marks or drawings.
key_questions: Can you count them again to check?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class total vegetable count.
lessons.home_link: Count vegetables at home before a meal.

lessons.title: What Is Harvest?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain that harvest is when farmers gather grown crops.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at pictures of a farm during harvest time.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss the harvest process (growing, gathering, sharing food) using simple sequencing pictures.
key_questions: What does a farmer do at harvest time?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of harvest process — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap the harvest process together.
lessons.home_link: Talk about where your food is grown/harvested.

lessons.title: Autumn Leaf Collage
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to arrange and stick natural materials to create a collage.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at and feel collected autumn leaves.
lessons.main_activity: Children arrange and glue autumn leaves/natural materials onto paper to create a collage picture (e.g. a tree or pattern).
key_questions: What are you creating with the leaves?

differentiation.extension: Create a specific picture (e.g. hedgehog, tree) with the leaves

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe creative arrangement and material use — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Display autumn leaf collages.
lessons.home_link: Collect autumn leaves on a walk and talk about their colours.

lessons.title: Autumn Feelings: Cosy and Calm
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a cosy/calm feeling associated with autumn.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what makes us feel cosy (blankets, warm drinks).
lessons.main_activity: Create a 'cosy corner' discussion; children describe what makes them feel cosy and calm as the weather cools.
key_questions: How does autumn weather make you feel?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note emotional vocabulary — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Share cosy feelings in the class cosy corner.
lessons.home_link: Enjoy a cosy activity with family this evening.

lessons.title: Listening to Autumn Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify sounds associated with autumn (crunching leaves, wind, rain).
lessons.starter_activity: Guess an autumn sound recording (leaves crunching).
lessons.main_activity: Listen to and discuss recordings/live demonstrations of autumn sounds, matching to picture cards.
resources_needed: Autumn sound recordings or real leaves to crunch
key_questions: When would you hear this outside?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note auditory discrimination — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of autumn sounds identified.
lessons.home_link: Listen for autumn sounds on a walk together.

lessons.title: Threading Autumn Leaf Garlands
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to thread leaves/conkers onto string with control.
lessons.starter_activity: Practise pincer grip with small natural objects.
lessons.main_activity: Children thread holes-punched leaves or conkers onto string/wool to make an autumn garland.
key_questions: Can you thread it through the hole?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor precision — evidence for PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Display garlands around the classroom.
lessons.home_link: Make a nature garland together outside.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'Leaf Man' by Lois Ehlert
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to make a prediction about where the leaf man might travel.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict the story from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read 'Leaf Man', pausing to predict where the wind might take the leaf man next.
key_questions: Where do you think the wind will take him?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note prediction/reasoning skills — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss the real leaf man's journey and compare to predictions.
lessons.home_link: Make up a story about where a leaf might travel in the wind.

lessons.title: Sorting Leaves by Size and Colour
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sort natural objects using more than one criterion.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a mixed pile of leaves.
lessons.main_activity: Children sort collected leaves by size (big/small) and then re-sort by colour, discussing their choices.
key_questions: Can you sort them a different way?

differentiation.extension: Sort by 2+ criteria and explain reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sorting/classifying skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Share different sorting methods used.
lessons.home_link: Sort collected natural objects at home by size or colour.

lessons.title: Why Do Leaves Change Colour?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe that leaves change colour and fall in autumn.
lessons.starter_activity: Compare a green summer leaf picture to an autumn leaf.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss simply why leaves change colour and fall as the weather gets colder; observe real examples.
key_questions: What colour do leaves turn in autumn?
What happens to leaves as it gets colder?

differentiation.extension: Explain the seasonal change in more detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note early scientific reasoning about seasons — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap why leaves change in autumn.
lessons.home_link: Look for different coloured leaves on a walk.

lessons.title: Autumn Leaves Dance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move expressively like falling/blowing leaves.
lessons.starter_activity: Watch a leaf fall (real or video) and discuss its movement.
lessons.main_activity: Children move expressively to music, imagining they are leaves falling, spinning, and blowing in the wind.
key_questions: How does a leaf move in the wind?
Can you show me falling gently?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe expressive movement — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite leaf movement performed.
lessons.home_link: Watch leaves falling outside and move like them together.

lessons.title: Dressing for Autumn Weather
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to choose appropriate clothing for cooler autumn weather.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss today's weather and what we're wearing.
lessons.main_activity: Sort clothing picture cards into 'autumn appropriate' vs 'not appropriate', and practise simple dressing skills (zips, buttons) with real coats.
resources_needed: Clothing picture cards, coats with zips/buttons
key_questions: Can you zip up your coat?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note self-care/independence skill and weather awareness — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap appropriate autumn clothing.
lessons.home_link: Practise zipping/buttoning your own coat at home.

lessons.title: Explaining Weather Changes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain a weather change using 'because'.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult models: 'I'm wearing a coat because it's cold.'
lessons.main_activity: Children complete and share 'It is ___ because ___' sentences about the day's weather.
key_questions: Why do we need a coat today?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note causal language use — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Class weather report recap.
lessons.home_link: Discuss and explain today's weather with family.

lessons.title: Windy Weather Movement Games
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move like objects affected by wind (kites, leaves, pinwheels) with control.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what wind does to objects outside.
lessons.main_activity: Children move like different wind-affected objects (spinning like a pinwheel, floating like a kite) around the space.
key_questions: How does the wind make things move?
Can you spin like a pinwheel?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note coordination and expressive movement — evidence for PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Cool down; discuss favourite wind movement.
lessons.home_link: Fly a kite or watch things move in the wind together if possible.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'r'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'r' and blend words (run, rat, rug).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'r' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'r'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 14 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending run, rat, rug.

lessons.title: Measuring Pumpkin/Marrow Circumference
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare circumference using non-standard units (string/hands).
lessons.starter_activity: Guess which of two pumpkins/vegetables is bigger around.
lessons.main_activity: Children use string or hand-spans to measure around a pumpkin/marrow and compare with a partner's.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note early measurement skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of biggest/smallest measured.
lessons.home_link: Measure something round at home using string or hands.

lessons.title: Exploring a Pumpkin
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to make observations about a pumpkin's inside and outside.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict what's inside a pumpkin.
lessons.main_activity: (With adult support) safely open and explore a pumpkin, observing seeds, flesh, and texture.
resources_needed: Pumpkin, safe tools for adult to cut, trays

differentiation.support: Observe and describe with adult prompts
differentiation.extension: Count seeds or compare texture to another vegetable

lessons.assessment_notes: Note observational and scientific language — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Share the most interesting discovery.
lessons.home_link: Explore a fruit or vegetable's inside together at home (with supervision).

lessons.title: Pumpkin/Autumn Painting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to mix colours to create autumn tones (orange, brown, red).
lessons.starter_activity: Look at autumn colour examples (leaves, pumpkins).
lessons.main_activity: Children experiment with mixing red/yellow paint to create orange and other autumn tones, painting a pumpkin or autumn scene.
key_questions: What colours did you mix to make orange?
What other autumn colours can you make?

differentiation.extension: Mix and name new colour combinations independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe colour-mixing understanding — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Display autumn-toned paintings.
lessons.home_link: Mix colours together using paint or coloured pencils at home.

lessons.title: Gratitude Circle: What Am I Thankful For?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express one thing they are thankful for.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult shares something they are thankful for.
lessons.main_activity: Circle time sharing 'I am thankful for ___' linked to the harvest theme, creating a class gratitude tree/display.
key_questions: Why does it matter to you?

differentiation.extension: Explain why they're thankful in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective/grateful language — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the class gratitude tree.
lessons.home_link: Share something you're thankful for with family at dinner.

lessons.title: Retelling the Harvest Process
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell the stages of harvest in sequence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Monday's harvest process discussion.
lessons.main_activity: Using picture cards, children retell the harvest process (plant, grow, harvest, eat/share) using sequencing words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing and narrative skill — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: One group retells the process to the class.
lessons.home_link: Explain the harvest process to a family member.

lessons.title: Making Pumpkin Seed Necklaces
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to thread pumpkin seeds or similar small objects with control.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap threading practice from Tuesday.
lessons.main_activity: Children thread dried pumpkin seeds (or beads if allergy concerns) onto string to create an autumn necklace.
resources_needed: Dried pumpkin seeds or beads, string
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor precision — evidence for PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Wear and admire finished necklaces.
lessons.home_link: Practise threading small safe objects at home.

lessons.title: Writing an Autumn Word List
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write simple autumn-themed words.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned this week and this term.
lessons.main_activity: Children write/draw a simple autumn word list (leaf, mud, sun) using known phonics sounds.
key_questions: What autumn word will you write?
What sound does it start with?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress across the half-term — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share autumn word lists with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write an autumn word together at home.

lessons.title: Number Bonds to 5 Recap with Conkers
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall number bonds to 5 confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire number bonds to 5 quiz.
lessons.main_activity: Using conkers/acorns, children practise and record all number bonds to 5 systematically.
key_questions: What are all the ways to make 5?
Can you recall this without counting?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess number bond fluency — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of all bonds to 5.
lessons.home_link: Practise number bonds to 5 with natural objects found outside.

lessons.title: Animals Preparing for Autumn/Winter
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how one animal prepares for colder weather.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what a squirrel does with nuts.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss simply how animals like squirrels (storing food), hedgehogs (hibernating), and birds (migrating) prepare for winter.
key_questions: What does a squirrel do with acorns?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note early understanding of animal adaptation — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap how different animals prepare for winter.
lessons.home_link: Look for squirrels or signs of animals preparing for winter outside.

lessons.title: Hedgehog/Squirrel Role-Play Movement
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move imaginatively like an autumn animal.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how a hedgehog curls up and a squirrel scurries.
lessons.main_activity: Children move imaginatively around the space as different autumn animals, responding to prompts (scurry, curl up, hide).
key_questions: Can you scurry like a squirrel?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe imaginative movement — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite animal movement performed.
lessons.home_link: Act out an autumn animal for family.

lessons.title: Celebrating Autumn Term 1
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on and share something they enjoyed learning this half-term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole half-term's themes (me, body, family, home, healthy me, helpers, harvest).
lessons.main_activity: Children share their favourite memory/learning from the half-term, contributing to a celebration display.
key_questions: What was your favourite thing we learned?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply
differentiation.extension: Explain in detail why it was a favourite

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and half-term progress overview — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class celebration of a successful first half-term.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite school memory from this half-term with family.

lessons.title: Autumn and Harvest Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about autumn and harvest learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's key vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about harvest, leaves, weather, and animals from the week.
key_questions: What do squirrels do with acorns?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and listening comprehension — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Team points tally, celebrate together.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on autumn facts learned this week.

lessons.title: Autumn Sports Challenge
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to combine jumping, throwing, and balance skills in an autumn-themed challenge.
lessons.starter_activity: Warm-up stretches recapping the week's PD vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Autumn-themed challenge circuit: jump into leaf piles, throw conkers into a bucket, balance-walk carrying a pumpkin (soft ball).
key_questions: What skill did you use here?
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 7 and half-term PD progress — evidence for PD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Cool down and celebrate completing Autumn 1's PD challenges.
lessons.home_link: Try an autumn-themed obstacle challenge at home/park.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 14 Sounds (End of Autumn 1)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all 14 sounds learned this half-term.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 14 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading (e.g. 'the sun is red').
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise Autumn 1 phonics tracker summary for all children.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned this half-term with a big reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over half-term break.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Half-Term Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, number bonds, shape, and measuring skills learned this half-term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths vocabulary from the half-term.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through stations reviewing counting, number bonds to 5, shape recognition, and simple measuring.
resources_needed: Station resources from across the half-term
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise Autumn 1 maths progress for each child against MATHS.1/MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all maths skills from the half-term.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting and number bonds over half-term break.

lessons.title: Autumn Half-Term Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key autumn/harvest learning from the week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's UTW learning.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Autumn Discoveries' display summarising harvest, leaves, weather, and animal learning.
key_questions: What was the most interesting thing we learned about autumn?
What will you look for outside now?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of half-term UTW learning — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Unveil and admire the finished 'Autumn Discoveries' display.
lessons.home_link: Go on an autumn discovery walk with your family over the break.

lessons.title: Autumn 1 Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform songs/movements learned across the half-term confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap favourite songs/dances from the half-term.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class celebration performance combining favourite songs and movements from Autumn 1 (feelings song, family dance, exercise routine, leaf dance).
key_questions: What was your favourite performance from this half-term?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment across the half-term's EAD learning — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; celebrate a wonderful first half-term at school.
lessons.home_link: Perform a favourite song/dance from this half-term for family over the break.
